summary: In June 2026 a threat actor published an alleged 25 GB Elaraby Group database on the pwnforums cybercrime forum, containing customer records, shipping addresses and sales transaction logs from elarabygroup.com. The Egyptian consumer electronics company had been listed by LockBit in May 2024.
